name: Ray-AABB Intersection
aliases: Ray-AABB Intersection — Slab Method, Min-Max Method, AABB Ray Intersection
definition: Intersects rays against axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABBs) centered at points. Implements a batching hack to avoid out-of-memory errors by processing rays in chunks.
summary: Ray-AABB Intersection computes ray entry and exit distances using the slab method, distinguished by its GPU-optimized batched kernel implementation for volume rendering.
